parsed.name: PCAN CAN 总线接口适配器
parsed.description: 这是一类用于将计算机连接到 CAN 或 CAN FD 网络的 PCAN 硬件接口适配器，常见形式包括 USB、PCI 或其他 PCAN 通道设备。它可用于实验室中与工业控制器、汽车电子节点、机器人部件或其他基于 CAN 的仪器通信，执行报文发送、总线监听、状态诊断、设备识别和总线恢复等任务。
parsed.description_en: This is a PCAN hardware interface adapter used to connect a computer to a CAN or CAN FD network, commonly provided as USB, PCI, or other PCAN channel devices. In laboratories it is used to communicate with industrial controllers, automotive electronics, robotic subsystems, or other CAN-based instruments for message transmission, bus monitoring, status diagnostics, device identification, and bus recovery.
